ui.hub.links.incoming_outcome.note: One dry-run report row in the incoming preview (one item): {item} is the escaped display label, {outcome} is core's ItemOutcome word (would-merge, up-to-date, unavailable...) and is not translated.

ui.hub.links.incoming_nothing.tone: plain; states a no-op, never an error
ui.hub.links.incoming_nothing.note: Shown inline instead of opening the preview dialog when the dry run says nothing would change. {outcome} is core's stable vocabulary word, not translated.

ui.hub.links.name_ambiguous.tone: plain; explains a refusal without blaming the reader
ui.hub.links.name_ambiguous.note: Older-core name addressing only: two loaded rows share a display name case-insensitively, and core's name arm matches every one of them, so a direct apply/retry would write both. No placeholders; the item's detail view is where the fix is.
